excavation_context.uniform: A light purple tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts and black hiking boots.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_3 is driving a wide rock chisel into a rough, pebble-packed tan conglomerate mass using a mallet. The block is filled with distinct, smooth river pebbles tightly cemented together, forming a high-hardness matrix surrounding a long, double-pronged neck vertebra of an Amargasaurus. Intense, direct sunlight casting hard shadows. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
